name: Proxima b
tagline: El exoplaneta más cercano a la Tierra — un mundo de masa terrestre en la zona habitable de Próxima.

facts.label: Descubierto
facts.value: 2016 — ESO Pale Red Dot (Anglada-Escudé et al.)

history: Proxima b orbits the closest star to the Sun, making it the nearest known exoplanet — and it sits inside the red dwarf's habitable zone, completing a year every 11.2 days. So close to its star it is almost certainly tidally locked: one hemisphere in permanent day, one in permanent night, with a twilight terminator where any temperate climate would concentrate. The catch is Proxima itself — a flare star that bathes the planet in ultraviolet and X-ray bursts strong enough to strip atmospheres. Whether b kept its air and water is one of the defining open questions for JWST and the coming generation of extremely large telescopes.
source: ESO Pale Red Dot; Nature (Anglada-Escudé et al., 2016)
